Tutorial
Python Flashcards App

In this tutorial, you'll build a flashcards app in Python, step by step. You'll start with the simplest possible version - one question, one answer - and gradually turn it into a fully‑featured app with multiple questions, shuffling, scoring, and user‑selected options. Each level adds one clear improvement to the previous version, so you can see exactly how small changes grow into a real program.

Tutorial
Scratch Platformer Game

In this tutorial, you'll build a platformer game in Scratch, step by step. You'll control a player that jumps around, collects stars, and earns points, while a bat enemy chases you. If the bat touches you — game over. Each level adds one small upgrade, so you can clearly see how a simple game turns into a complete one.
